race.comment: ASTAPOR (9) has the most persuasive recent profile, with two Open placings in the space of a week and a last-start third at Chinchilla where he came from a long way back to be beaten four and a half lengths. The rise to 1200m is a query rather than a negative, but his current consistency and recent-rating edge make him the horse to beat. EGYPITIAN'S REWARD (11) is the obvious danger after missing by a neck at Kumbia in BM55 grade, and she gets weight relief from that run. VELOCE METEOR (5) has put together consecutive seconds in BM55 company, had excuses when wide and held up at Barcaldine, and is already proven at this track and distance. TERAMBI (4) is more of a value threat, coming back from BM65 grade after a narrow Dalby defeat and bringing a strong record at this track and trip. A LOT OF BOOTY (6) won't be far away.
